locations.name: Asterion
locations.description: Political and cultural center of the empire. Lumencia Academy is located here.

locations.name: Lumencia Academy
locations.description: The empire's most prestigious academy and a central meeting point for talented nobles and commoners. Officially politically neutral, but factions use it to recruit allies and build influence.

locations.name: Remaria
locations.description: A temperate southern coastal city known as the City of Arts, with theatre, opera, poetry, painting and magical crafts.

locations.name: Orpherum
locations.description: A southeastern port with sea markets, maritime guilds and a history associated with piracy; a Navigator Guild and Sea Temple are mentioned in the public adaptation.

locations.name: Rubelin
locations.description: A city in the northwestern plains associated with scholarship, botany, pharmacy and alchemical research.

locations.name: Prima Glacie
locations.description: A far-northern icy mountain region known for severe cold and frequent blizzards.

locations.name: Zaraha
locations.description: A southwestern desert with ancient ruins, golden temples, extreme day/night temperature changes and sandstorms.

locations.name: Grand Hall
locations.description: The academy's ceremonial heart: a vast marble hall with tall windows and the imperial crest, used for the entrance ceremony, assemblies, award ceremonies and the Founders' Gala.

locations.name: Training Grounds
locations.description: Sand yards, duelling rings and an enclosed arena of the Knight wing, where classes, sparring, mock battles and tournaments take place. Always echoing with steel.

locations.name: Magic Wing
locations.description: Lecture halls, reinforced casting chambers and laboratories of the Magic Department, where the mana detection crystal stands. Minor explosions are a daily occurrence.

locations.name: Chapel of Lily
locations.description: The Theology wing's white chapel, dedicated to Lily, with an infirmary where Aria and the theology students heal the wounded of training and missions.

locations.name: Great Library
locations.description: A multi-storey library of books, scrolls and magical treatises. Its restricted section requires a professor's authorization.

locations.name: Refectory
locations.description: The great dining hall shared by all wings; nobles and commoners tend to sit apart. A crossroads of rumours.

locations.name: Dormitories
locations.description: Hall A for first-years, Hall B for second-years, Hall C for third-years; each hall is separated between women and men, and by wing.

locations.name: Headmaster's Office
locations.description: Emily's office at the top of the main building: elegant, cluttered with paperwork and always stocked with sweets.

locations.name: Student Council Room
locations.description: The council's chamber, where Anastasia and Lucia run academy operations, events and examinations.

locations.name: Academy Gardens
locations.description: Courtyards, rose gardens and paths between the buildings; the White Rose Society holds outdoor receptions here.

locations.name: The Tower
locations.description: The Magic Tower of Asterion, seat of the Tower Master Ethera: the Empire's highest centre of magical research. Its upper floors are closed to all but Ethera and those she invites, such as her apprentice Rena.

locations.name: Imperial Palace
locations.description: Seat of the imperial family and of the Imperial Guard commanded by Carne. The heart of the succession war.

locations.name: Valenheart Domain
locations.description: The lands of the Valenheart Duchy, a fortress-castle surrounded by training fields where knights of the house are forged in martial prowess and honour.

locations.name: Caldwin Domain
locations.description: The lands of the Caldwin Duchy, with a palace-library filled with magical archives and the family's private research halls.

locations.name: Lumina
locations.description: The capital of the Holy Kingdom of Dominus, a white city of cathedrals dedicated to Lily, where combat theologians, inquisitors and healers are trained.

locations.name: Abyss Zone
locations.description: The far east of Aethermere: a corrupted land where Miasma leaks from Delphirem's seal and demonic beasts spawn. The Demon God Cult's headquarters lies hidden deep inside.
